title: UN Commission finding on sexualized torture of Palestinian detainees
summary: The Commission made findings concerning sexualized torture and sexual violence against Palestinian male detainees.
claim: The Commission found that persecutory acts continued in detention as sexualized torture and that male detainees were subjected to attacks on sexual and reproductive organs and to rape.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding that included war-crime and crime-against-humanity characterizations for rape, sexual violence and torture; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 108 of A/79/232. This later report expressly supports the sexualized-torture formulation. The record attributes all factual and legal findings to the Commission and does not present them as court convictions.
